scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ ! -d server/node_modules ] || [ ! -d client/node_modules ]; then npm run postinstall; elif [ ! -d server/node_modules/.prisma ]; then npm --prefix server run prisma:generate; fi; ENABLE_STARTUP_JOB_SYNC=false npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix client run dev -- --port 3000 --host 0.0.0.0'
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
